title: Supermarket (DS)
wikitext: The '''Supermarket''' is a shop in ''[[Harvest Moon DS]]'' and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]''. The Supermarket can be reached via telephone and is open from 9am until 5pm every day except for Tuesdays and holidays. [[Karen (DS)|Karen]] runs the store and sells seasonal seeds, items and food.
